about.title: About
about.text:
NICHE was born from a love for thoughtful details, individual expression, and the beauty of things made with intention. More than a clothing brand, it is a space where creativity meets craftsmanship, and everyday essentials become something personal.
Behind NICHE is a vision of making fashion feel more individual — where every embroidered detail tells a story, reflects a feeling, or carries a meaning of its own.
Created for those who appreciate subtle statements over loud trends, NICHE celebrates individuality through timeless pieces, meaningful designs, and the art of making something truly yours.
Not just what you wear. A reflection of who you are.
